priority: 90% final-art visual fidelity determines code-versus-image ownership
simpleForms: Code only when it can closely reproduce approved reference: simple wall planes, posts, ropes, connecting areas.
complexForms: Use existing approved assets for style-defining roof silhouettes, gate structures, timber detail; use more complete building materials if code approximation does not match.
gapHandling: Explicitly identify missing material; do not replace complex architecture with unlike generic code buildings.
sequence: First refine one representative screen against final style, then extend continuous longmap.
